reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is https://<user-hostname>/health constructed from param=request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). Although DNS resolution occurs at line 41 and a non-public check happens at line 42, the actual outbound fetch at line 44 calls openUrlByHostname(host) which builds the URL using the original unvalidated host string. The resolved sink value depends entirely on attacker-controlled input (param/host), enabling SSRF attacks where malicious hostnames can reach internal resources despite the DNS-based check.
